name: Point Nepean National Park
bio_draft: southern tip of the peninsula with Fort Nepean, beaches, walks and the Quarantine Station.

name: Peninsula Hot Springs
bio_draft: mineral bathing complex at Fingal with thermal pools and spa.

name: Cape Schanck Lighthouse
bio_draft: working lightstation at the tip of the peninsula on Bass Strait, with its reserve and rock views.

name: Fort Nepean
bio_draft: 19th-century coastal fort in Point Nepean National Park, open to visitors with guided and self-guided access.

name: Mornington Peninsula National Park
bio_draft: strip of ocean beaches, cliffs and bushland from Point Nepean to Cape Schanck, with walks and surf beaches.

name: Sorrento
bio_draft: historic seaside town where Victoria's first settlement was founded in 1803, with ocean and bay beaches and the ferry to Queenscliff.
